note: Extra source feeds on top of the built-in Ajuntament press API and Betevé RSS. Apify is a transport: it reads the last successful run of an Apify task (or a dataset) that someone set up, and needs APIFY_TOKEN in the environment. Every item still has to pass allowlist.json (individuals' accounts are blocked in code), the health filter and a reviewer. maxConfidence caps what an item from this feed can carry: low, medium or high. fields maps the dataset's keys (dotted paths allowed) to url, title, text and date; omitted keys use common defaults.
